spans.s:
कियत् कियत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. 1. कि), how
great? how large? how far? how much? of what extent?
of what qualities? (Ved. loc. कियाति with following
आ, how long ago? since what time? e. g. कियात्य् आ
प्रथमः सर्ग आसाम्, how long is it since their first
creation? कियत्य् अध्वनि, at what distance? how
far off? कियद् एतद् with gen., of what importance
is this to any one? तेन कियान् अर्थः, what profit
arises from that? कियच् चिरेण, in how long a
time? कियद् दूरे, how far?); little, small, unim-
portant, of small value (often in compounds, e. g.
कियद्-वक्र, a little bent; कियन्-मात्र, of little
importance; कियद् अपि, how large or how far soever,
&c.; यावत् कियच्च, how large or how much soever,
of what qualities soever; (कियत्), ind. how far?
how much? how? a little; कियत्-कालम्, how long?
some little time ago.
—कियद्-एतिका or कियद्-एहिका,
f. effort, vigorous and persevering exertions according
to one's strength.
—कियद्-दूर, अस्, आ, अम्, for a
short distance, a little way.
—कियन्-मूल्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, of what value? of what price?

कियाम्बु कियाम्बु, उ, n., Ved. a kind of
aquatic plant.

कियाह कियाह, अस्, m. a fox, a horse of
a red or bay colour.

कियेधा किये-धा, आस्, आस्, अम् (fr. कियद्-धा?),
Ved. containing or surrounding much, epithet of Indra.
